title: Infra — Resource Usage
description: CPU, memory, disk and network usage of the OAN services.

query.rawSql:
SELECT DISTINCT ResourceAttributes['k8s.namespace.name'] AS namespace
FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge
WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeUnix)
  AND MetricName = 'k8s.pod.cpu.usage'
ORDER BY namespace

SELECT DISTINCT multiIf(ServiceName != '', ServiceName, ResourceAttributes['k8s.deployment.name'] != '', ResourceAttributes['k8s.deployment.name'], ResourceAttributes['k8s.statefulset.name'] != '', ResourceAttributes['k8s.statefulset.name'], ResourceAttributes['k8s.daemonset.name'] != '', ResourceAttributes['k8s.daemonset.name'], ResourceAttributes['k8s.job.name'] != '', ResourceAttributes['k8s.job.name'], ResourceAttributes['k8s.pod.name']) AS service
FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge
WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeUnix)
  AND MetricName = 'k8s.pod.cpu.usage'
  AND $__conditionalAll(ResourceAttributes['k8s.namespace.name'] IN ($namespace), $namespace)
ORDER BY service

options.content: CPU, memory, disk and network usage of the OAN services, collected every 20 seconds.

panels.title: CPU usage
panels.description: CPU used by each service. 100% equals one full CPU core.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT time, service, sum(v) AS value
FROM (
  SELECT
    $__timeInterval(TimeUnix) AS time,
    multiIf(ServiceName != '', ServiceName, ResourceAttributes['k8s.deployment.name'] != '', ResourceAttributes['k8s.deployment.name'], ResourceAttributes['k8s.statefulset.name'] != '', ResourceAttributes['k8s.statefulset.name'], ResourceAttributes['k8s.daemonset.name'] != '', ResourceAttributes['k8s.daemonset.name'], ResourceAttributes['k8s.job.name'] != '', ResourceAttributes['k8s.job.name'], ResourceAttributes['k8s.pod.name']) AS service,
    ResourceAttributes['k8s.pod.uid'] AS pod,
    avg(Value) * 100 AS v
  FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge
  WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeUnix)
    AND MetricName = 'k8s.pod.cpu.usage'
    AND $__conditionalAll(ResourceAttributes['k8s.namespace.name'] IN ($namespace), $namespace)
  AND $__conditionalAll(multiIf(ServiceName != '', ServiceName, ResourceAttributes['k8s.deployment.name'] != '', ResourceAttributes['k8s.deployment.name'], ResourceAttributes['k8s.statefulset.name'] != '', ResourceAttributes['k8s.statefulset.name'], ResourceAttributes['k8s.daemonset.name'] != '', ResourceAttributes['k8s.daemonset.name'], ResourceAttributes['k8s.job.name'] != '', ResourceAttributes['k8s.job.name'], ResourceAttributes['k8s.pod.name']) IN ($service), $service)
  GROUP BY time, service, pod
)
GROUP BY time, service
ORDER BY time

panels.title: Volume usage
panels.description: Share of each persistent volume in use, such as the database volumes.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  $__timeInterval(TimeUnix) AS time,
  ResourceAttributes['k8s.persistentvolumeclaim.name'] AS volume,
  100 * (1 - avgIf(Value, MetricName = 'k8s.volume.available') / nullIf(avgIf(Value, MetricName = 'k8s.volume.capacity'), 0)) AS used
FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge
WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeUnix)
  AND MetricName IN ('k8s.volume.available', 'k8s.volume.capacity')
  AND ResourceAttributes['k8s.persistentvolumeclaim.name'] != ''
  AND $__conditionalAll(ResourceAttributes['k8s.namespace.name'] IN ($namespace), $namespace)
  AND $__conditionalAll(multiIf(ServiceName != '', ServiceName, ResourceAttributes['k8s.deployment.name'] != '', ResourceAttributes['k8s.deployment.name'], ResourceAttributes['k8s.statefulset.name'] != '', ResourceAttributes['k8s.statefulset.name'], ResourceAttributes['k8s.daemonset.name'] != '', ResourceAttributes['k8s.daemonset.name'], ResourceAttributes['k8s.job.name'] != '', ResourceAttributes['k8s.job.name'], ResourceAttributes['k8s.pod.name']) IN ($service), $service)
GROUP BY time, volume
ORDER BY time

panels.title: Network I/O
panels.description: Data received and sent over the network, per second.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT time, service, direction, sum(bps) AS value
FROM (
  SELECT
    time, service, direction,
    (v - lagInFrame(v) OVER w) / greatest(toUnixTimestamp(time) - toUnixTimestamp(lagInFrame(time) OVER w), 1) AS bps,
    row_number() OVER w AS rn
  FROM (
    SELECT
      $__timeInterval(TimeUnix) AS time,
      multiIf(ServiceName != '', ServiceName, ResourceAttributes['k8s.deployment.name'] != '', ResourceAttributes['k8s.deployment.name'], ResourceAttributes['k8s.statefulset.name'] != '', ResourceAttributes['k8s.statefulset.name'], ResourceAttributes['k8s.daemonset.name'] != '', ResourceAttributes['k8s.daemonset.name'], ResourceAttributes['k8s.job.name'] != '', ResourceAttributes['k8s.job.name'], ResourceAttributes['k8s.pod.name']) AS service,
      if(Attributes['direction'] = 'receive', 'in', 'out') AS direction,
      concat(ResourceAttributes['k8s.pod.uid'], '/', Attributes['interface']) AS series,
      max(Value) AS v
    FROM otel.otel_metrics_sum
    WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeUnix)
      AND MetricName = 'k8s.pod.network.io'
      AND $__conditionalAll(ResourceAttributes['k8s.namespace.name'] IN ($namespace), $namespace)
  AND $__conditionalAll(multiIf(ServiceName != '', ServiceName, ResourceAttributes['k8s.deployment.name'] != '', ResourceAttributes['k8s.deployment.name'], ResourceAttributes['k8s.statefulset.name'] != '', ResourceAttributes['k8s.statefulset.name'], ResourceAttributes['k8s.daemonset.name'] != '', ResourceAttributes['k8s.daemonset.name'], ResourceAttributes['k8s.job.name'] != '', ResourceAttributes['k8s.job.name'], ResourceAttributes['k8s.pod.name']) IN ($service), $service)
    GROUP BY time, service, direction, series
  )
  WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY service, direction, series ORDER BY time ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)
)
WHERE rn > 1 AND bps >= 0
GROUP BY time, service, direction
ORDER BY time
